subject.title: fix(agent): stale replies after queued user turns

question: Should legitimate queued user-authored orphan turns be preserved as context-only before the latest active prompt, while stale internal runtime handoffs are dropped?
rationale: Both preservation and unconditional dropping can prevent stale replies, but they differ on whether earlier legitimate user input remains model-visible; implementation evidence cannot choose that product semantic on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept combined semantics
options.body: Retain legitimate queued user text as context-only and discard classified internal completion handoffs when a fresh prompt exists.

options.title: Use latest prompt only
options.body: Discard every older orphan turn, including legitimate queued user-authored input, so only the latest prompt reaches the model.

options.title: Pause for another contract
options.body: Hold both candidate PRs until maintainers approve a different queued-turn and transcript-repair design.

recommendation.title: Accept combined semantics
recommendation.body: Retain legitimate queued user text as context-only and discard classified internal completion handoffs when a fresh prompt exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the exact-head combined repair and hold the current PR assignment, with steipete providing adjacent current-main behavior ownership.
